svg.title: A truthful track card: design mockup
svg.desc: A proposed track card and matching driving view using two actual captures of Storm Freight. Labels and interface are illustrative.

g.text: A proposed card and a race view of the same authored Storm Freight track.
Actual course, actual biome, actual objects
RECOMMENDED BASELINE / NO TRACK CAPTURE REQUIRED
Show the track players will actually drive.
A neutral card and the actual route work for user-created tracks.
Optional real track images can be added if and when available.
Show the real road, biome and objects; do not invent scenery.
The left trace uses the current Storm Freight JSON route data.
Capture availability and implementation cost are unverified.
Static design mockup · existing screenshots from 25 October 2026 · no game implementation or device performance claim
